scope: Real workshop player with an explicit fixture for both speaker forms, original drafts, unchanged prior results, stale callbacks and accent/assistance provenance. No AI quality claim.
checks: in-player agreement preserves drafts, controls actual grading and survives reload
a closed agreement menu cannot change preferences after navigation
exact own-word drafts survive reload, accent buttons, pause and navigation

accent-only restoration is visible and saved with the original submission
translated English produces explicitly assisted practice

typed drill draft resumes exactly after reload and navigation disposal
picker callbacks cannot mark a word or save a draft into another profile
